title: Global sections of residue-point pullback are tensor of the stalk
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and x a point with residue field kappa(x) [def-weil-residue-field]. The functor from O_X-module sheaves that first pulls back along i_x:Spec kappa(x)→X [def-pc-module-pullback], then takes global sections and restricts scalars along GammaSpecIso inverse, is naturally isomorphic to the composite of the module stalk functor at x [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] and extension of scalars along the residue map O_X,x→kappa(x). This holds for all module sheaves, without quasi-coherence or flatness.

source.place: Tag 0098, Lemma 6.26.4, specialized to a residue-field point with global sections on a singleton spectrum

proof.text: At the closed point y of Spec kappa(x), construct the global germ natural transformation after restricting global-section scalars by GammaSpecIso inverse and stalk scalars by stalkClosedPointIso inverse. Every neighborhood of y is top (IsLocalRing.closed_point_mem_iff); exists_germ_eq gives surjectivity, and germ_eq plus identity restrictions gives injectivity. Linearity follows from PresheafOfModules.germ_smul and GammaSpecIso_hom_stalkClosedPointIso_inv. The stalk-map germ formula gives naturality. NatIso.ofComponents of the resulting bijective linear maps gives globalStalkIso.

Obtain e from exists_tensorPullback_stalk_iso for fromSpecResidueField x at y. Whisker globalStalkIso by tensorPullback, then whisker e by restriction of scalars along stalkClosedPointIso inverse. This identifies the global sections with extension of the original stalk to the residue-point stalk ring, restricted to kappa(x).

For a ring isomorphism e:B->C, extendScalars e and restrictScalars e inverse are left adjoints of restrictScalars e, the latter through restrictScalarsEquivalenceOfRingEquiv. leftAdjointUniq identifies them, and extendScalarsComp then identifies extendScalars f followed by restriction along e inverse with extendScalars (e composed with f). Apply this to stalkClosedPointIso and the residue-point stalk map.

Use SpecToEquivOfLocalRing.apply_symm_apply at the pair (x,residue). The inverse morphism is definitionally fromSpecResidueField x. Apply congrArg to the function taking a point-local-ring-map pair to moduleStalkFunctor at the point followed by extendScalars of the map. This identifies the point and scalar map simultaneously, giving the exact right-hand functor. Compose all natural isomorphisms and this equality isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_residuePullback_globalSections_iso (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) :
    Nonempty
      (Modules.tensorPullback (X.fromSpecResidueField x) ⋙
          (SheafOfModules.evaluation
            (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace) (op ⊤) ⋙
              ModuleCat.restrictScalars (ΓSpecIso (X.residueField x)).inv.hom) ≅
        RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x ⋙
          ModuleCat.extendScalars (IsLocalRing.residue (X.presheaf.stalk x)))
